review.en: The third album by the Manila band Eraserheads, led by Ely Buendia, became one of the best-selling records in Philippine history. It moves between English and Tagalog, punk bursts and Beatles-style melody, and closes with Ang Huling El Bimbo, a seven-minute story of youth and loss that has become a national standard. Uneven across fifteen tracks, but central to Filipino rock.
review.zh: 马尼拉乐队 Eraserheads 的第三张专辑，主唱埃利·布恩迪亚，成了菲律宾史上最畅销的唱片之一。它在英语和他加禄语之间切换，有朋克式的爆发，也有披头士式的旋律，结尾的《Ang Huling El Bimbo》是一个七分钟的青春与失去的故事，已成为全民传唱的歌。十五首歌并不整齐，却是菲律宾摇滚的中心。
